build.label: com.we.build-dispatch-daemon

pass-readers.label: com.we.conveyor-pass-daemon.ci-red-recovery-watch-we
pass-readers.note: The label is the ci-red-recovery-watch-we pass daemon launchd job. No explicit clone: prototype-load resolves the clone from that installed plist WorkingDirectory, so overlays register on the clone the watcher actually runs from (the shipped template installs wev-review-daemon; the live install runs wev-pass-readers), and self-sync adopts the new code.
pass-readers.runs: reader pass daemons (ci-red-recovery-watch and the other read-only passes)

drain.label: com.plateau.drain-daemon
drain.note: The plist's DRAIN_DAEMON_WE_CLONE is the DATA clone lane-1, which carries no overlays. Register overlays on the CODE clone code; see scripts/settings/operator-task.json edgeClones.drain and scripts/lib/daemon-clone-registry.mjs.

pr-merge-watch.label: com.we.conveyor-pass-daemon.pr-merge-watch
pr-merge-watch.runs: PR merge watcher (ready-stuck alerts and guarded stale-check refresh)

merge-watch.label: com.we.conveyor-pass-daemon.merge-orphan-sweep
merge-watch.unsupported: its merge-orphan-sweep pass runs self-sync main-only (mainOnly=true), which excludes registered overlays, so a prototype loaded here would stay pending forever. Land the change through a normal PR instead.
merge-watch.runs: merge-watch helpers (pr-merge-watch, merge-orphan-sweep); NOT the merge-queue drain, use drain for that. Does not accept prototype loads (unsupported)

findings: red-team-check-run.mjs:87 policy-clear publication reads then posts without sharing the round writer's claim, so a concurrent round's in_progress check can be superseded by the policy-clear success (carded follow-up)
excluded-file drop made loud (config-excluded selected test files are named and not run, previously skipped silently)
focusRefs entry for lane/verify-forge-route added to scripts/settings/pr-limit.json
rebuild.mjs accepts inherited ignore-owner env for any readyOnly caller (feature-scope, PR 6222 body)
acquireWrite accepts explicit ignoreOwners that can bypass a listed foreign live reader (feature-scope)
preparation still writes refs/objects before the ref guard; read-only does not cover all clone bytes (feature-scope)
lock exclusion weakens the previous reader-exclusion guarantee (inherent to the feature)

scripts/operations/dispatch-lane.mjs:429 — Glob refusal applies only within multi-path entries; separate glob entries remain accepted despite the pre-existing overlap-check limitation. Probe: `we:src/a*b.mjs` and `we:src/ab*.mjs` both cover `we:src/abb.mjs`, but `scopesOverlap` returns false, allowing conflicting work through lease/rival exclusion.

scripts/readiness/forge-slot-markers.mjs:283 — Adds `idle` to the release allowlist, allowing deletion of markers for listed runs with `code:null` that previously remained blocked. Two zero-count samples replace per-run completion evidence. The underlying count comes from a non-atomic directory listing (scripts/readiness/forge-exec-run.mjs:647), so this loosens the fail-closed guard without proving that run’s cleanup.
The last-known-good fallback can proceed for up to the 2-min window after a freeze is newly published while reads keep timing out (PR #6289, accepted option A).
merge-gate still enforces the freeze per merge.

scripts/lib/drain-queue-safety.mjs:197 — Replaces the all-green requirement with an exception that discards FAILURE, CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT, ACTION_REQUIRED and STARTUP_FAILURE when a later same-name check succeeds in another run. Previously these outcomes blocked update-branch.

scripts/lib/drain-queue-safety.mjs:153 — Matching workflow_id, display name and timestamps does not prove job replacement across runs; independent same-name jobs can mask failures. The lookup validates only workflow_id, without binding the check to its claimed run/job or verifying equivalent execution context.

scripts/lib/drain-queue-safety.mjs:59 — One or two `merge_conflict` removals now bypass commit-binding validation and the same-head failure hold whenever the live PR is CLEAN. CLEAN does not prove the failed merge-group conditions changed; previously these cases required operator inspection.

scripts/__tests__/merge-ai-prs-prestage.test.mjs:188 — Replacing `merge_conflict` with `ci_failure` removes integration coverage that prevented a force-push from bypassing an unbound conflict failure. The test now passes despite that protection being removed.

The canonical Codex audit on head be8f9f2629 reports WEAKENED. The findings are exactly this ruled change: restarts are exempt from the shared per-head ceiling, and the tests that pinned "restarts spend / are blocked by the shared budget" were replaced by R452 tests (a second non-restart action on the same head is still refused, in current-pass, would-do and intent evidence). The sweep stays shadow-only.

scripts/settings/review.json:3 — Shipped timing changes from fast-check success to `push`, permitting review while both prerequisites are queued. Confirmed by a direct probe: pending checks now allow review, whereas the previous default refuses. `scripts/lib/review-timing.mjs:195` grants this permission even with `startEarly: "shadow"` or `"off"`; the added publication guard does not preserve the review-start gate.

scripts/merge-ai-prs.mjs:2686 — Pre-existing fail-open dependency handling remains: full sweeps clear absent `blockedBy` dependencies even when listing failures make `contextComplete=false`; an unreadable repo's open blocker can therefore be bypassed.

scripts/merge-ai-prs.mjs:5616 — Pre-existing `--assume-complete-context` overrides the incomplete-context guard after listing failures, allowing an unobserved carrier to count as landed despite the new inventory checks.

scripts/conveyor/reconcile-pass.mjs:456 — The snapshot-disabled fallback returns direct() without author validation, but PR_LIST_JSON_FIELDS omits author. This pre-existing bypass still accepts authorless rows despite the claimed fail-closed guarantee.

scripts/conveyor/reconcile-pass.mjs:471 — Fresh planner reads now rely on a paged reader that requests only `labels(first:100)` without checking label completeness (`scripts/lib/pr-list-paged.mjs:75`). Omitted `review-status:draft-withdrawn` or `red-team:blocked/pending` labels bypass promotion guards (`scripts/conveyor/reconcile-core.mjs:2769–2776`). A synthetic probe confirmed an incomplete label connection is accepted as complete; the added tests do not cover this fail-open path.

note — pre-existing limit shared with the snapshot path: the `labels(first:100)` page query is the same one the shared PR snapshot and the drain listing already use; a PR with more than 100 labels is not a realistic state, and this branch does not change that query.

scripts/lib/drain-red-team-evidence.mjs:76 — Retains the pre-existing reliance on mtime to select finished reviews; start times only protect unfinished reviews. An older acceptance updated after a newer rejection wins. A read-only probe confirmed recovery schedules a fresh pass using that stale acceptance, ignoring the newer rejection.

scripts/lib/drain-poison-guard.mjs:130 — The new API path relies on a pre-existing raw-text grep that misses YAML-escaped identities. Main’s `bornAs: "xabc12\u0033"` and an added card’s `bornAs: xabc123` decode identically, but a read-only probe returned `{ok:true}`, allowing the duplicate through admission.

scripts/lib/drain-queue-safety.mjs:59 — One or two `merge_conflict` removals now bypass commit-binding validation and the same-head failure hold whenever the live PR is CLEAN. CLEAN does not prove the failed merge-group conditions changed; previously these cases required operator inspection.

scripts/__tests__/merge-ai-prs-prestage.test.mjs:188 — Replacing `merge_conflict` with `ci_failure` removes integration coverage that prevented a force-push from bypassing an unbound conflict failure. The test now passes despite that protection being removed.

scripts/lib/policy-cascade.mjs:79 — Per-leaf merging retains the repository’s weaker build gates when an operator supplies only `build.priority` or `build: {}`. A read-only probe confirmed the effective policy changes from `full`/`always` to `related`/`selected`, reducing verification from the full unit suite plus standards to diff-selected checks (scripts/verify-lane.mjs:366).
scripts/lib/daemon-rebuild/overlay-main-sync.mjs:674 — A passing rerun of only failed files now permits publication after an initially failing run; the previous gate rejected that run outright.

scripts/lib/daemon-rebuild/overlay-main-sync.mjs:694 — Matching failed assertion identities on main now clears retry state and returns a skip, bypassing the existing failure outcome and operator-alert escalation; matching names do not establish matching causes.

scripts/lib/daemon-rebuild/overlay-main-sync.mjs:343 — Cached main-red evidence bypasses retesting for six hours by default, delaying detection of changed environmental failures even when commit SHAs remain unchanged.

scripts/lib/daemon-rebuild/overlay-main-sync.mjs:276 — Missing, unreadable, or invalid rerun configuration falls back to allowing one rerun, enabling the weaker publication policy instead of retaining the original fail-closed behavior.
scripts/conveyor/__tests__/prep-review.test.mjs:301 — Raises this test’s timeout to 30 seconds; the same relaxation at line 659 allows slower or stalled behavior to escape the previous timeout guard.

scripts/lib/drain-red-team-evidence.mjs:541 — Replaces the foreign-host fail-closed hold with an age-based local PID check. Different machines can both have null PID namespaces; an absent or mismatched local PID cannot prove the remote writer stopped. After 30 minutes (configurable down to 10), a live remote review can lose its in-flight/queued protection, allowing review-job.mjs:387 to admit a replacement writer and overwrite its status.

scripts/lib/review-red-team-on-skip.mjs:791 — Pre-existing limitation relied on by scripts/lib/red-team-dispatch-queue.mjs:171: worker-free `carry` publishes policy-clear without revalidating live holds or complete formal reviews. A read-only probe selected `carry` with zero live-state or complete-review reads despite readers configured to report a hold; a hold arriving after the snapshot can therefore be bypassed.

scripts/lib/daemon-rebuild/adopt.mjs:132 — The legacy allowlist bypasses tip binding and recorded `contentInMain`/`cleanMerges` evidence for the specified event, allowing superseded adoption previously refused. Direct probes confirmed acceptance with both a missing and a mismatched tip; candidate tree, driver, and time checks remain.

scripts/lib/drain-merge-strategy.mjs:432 — Check-run mode skips live evidence and disposition validation. An older successful check can authorize enqueue despite a later confirmed-break comment, operator block, or revoked deferral when blocking labels are absent.

scripts/merge-gate-check.mjs:194 — Publication holds do not prevent stale-success admission: after the check read, a writer can publish a newer pending check and clear its publication hold before the status read. An injected read-only probe returned success while the latest check was in progress.

scripts/settings/pr-stall-sweep.json:10 — Enables live restarts under global `mode: "shadow"`; shadow no longer guarantees zero dispatches. (R804: per-action live with global shadow is the ruled change)

scripts/conveyor/pr-stall-sweep.mjs:342 — Treats a missing PID namespace as matching locally. A stale record from another machine can therefore be declared dead by a local PID probe. (R803: ruled single-host exception inherited from #6603)
scripts/conveyor/pr-stall-sweep.mjs:152 — Operator resets discard earlier restart spend from lifetime caps, spacing, and idempotency checks. (R804: the recorded operator reset is the ruled action)

scripts/lib/gh-throttle.mjs:2012 — Raises the configured concurrency ceiling from cap to cap + 1 for reserved freeze reads, allowing execution when the original gate would throttle. The passthrough path repeats this override at line 2288.

scripts/conveyor/hung-session.mjs:444 — Replaces the absolute pending-tool-call veto with an age-and-idle override, allowing unfinished calls to be classified as finished without observing completion.

scripts/conveyor/reconcile-core.mjs:1167 — Already-hung rows skip the new fresh-status check. The preceding hung detector releases pending calls at the same grace threshold, so even a fresh busy/waiting status cannot enforce the claimed protection.

scripts/conveyor/soak/breaks/idle-row-dangling-call-holds-pr.mjs:57 — fixPresent runs the same scenario as the test; a behavioral regression returns false and selects it.fails in defineBreakTest, allowing the regression to pass as an expected failure.

scripts/conveyor/ci-red-recovery-watch.mjs:1493 — Legacy candidates skip preflight entirely. A completed required failure plus another absent context still qualifies, bypassing live evidence validation and, for classic candidates, the PR-wide retry cap.

scripts/conveyor/missing-run-push.mjs:73 — Writer admission is optional, and the production trigger at ci-red-recovery-watch.mjs:1525 supplies none of its enabling inputs. Writer tests explicitly inject those inputs, so they cannot detect production bypassing evidence and cap checks.

scripts/conveyor/fix-claim-store.mjs:92 — The claim reader treats directory-read errors as no claims and skips unreadable or corrupt entries. Both new admission and existing writer checks therefore accept an unreadable claim store as unclaimed, despite their fail-closed assertions.

scripts/lib/red-team-withheld-publish.mjs:103 — Legacy recovery relies on marker-only deduplication without comparing the posted comment against recovered findings. Reproduced: a seat row containing one confirmed break plus an existing trusted “no break found” comment returns `skipped`, writes nothing, raises no alert, and leaves the gate seeing zero findings. Conflicting evidence silently bypasses the hold.

scripts/operations/operator-controls-io.mjs:150 — The new operation resets exhausted resumeFailures to zero, bypassing the existing three-failure stop and permitting additional resume attempts on the same head.

scripts/operations/operator-controls.mjs:108 — The advertised two-reset limit relies solely on record.operatorResets. The existing re-mark path (scripts/conveyor/await-verify.mjs:404) preserves resumeFailures but drops operatorResets, allowing repeated same-head re-marks to replenish the reset budget indefinitely.

skills-src/conveyor/review-daemon.mjs:1262 — Overrides host.maxReviewDispatchPerTick: defaults raise 2 to 3 at CPU idle >= 10% (operator-ruled R816/R818 B; one start stays reserved for ordinary reviews).
scripts/lib/red-team-dispatch-queue.mjs:71 — The floor raises remainingStarts (including 0) up to a host-supplied ceiling (operator-ruled R816: min 2 concurrent red-team runs while CPU idle >= 10%).
